note: Pointers only. Everything listed exists in the amado2k5/cookwala repository; nothing here is a third-party product. Anyone may run a registry (RFC-0002, RFC-0006).

entries.name: ai.cookwala/reference-catalog
entries.description: The reference Cookwala catalog: schemas, vocabularies, example recipes and feeds.

entries.name: ai.cookwala/examples
entries.description: Example recipes used by the specification and the dry run. Verification level V1 or V2; not field-verified.

entries.name: ai.cookwala/safety-limits-default
entries.description: Draft default on-device safety limits for planning and conformance tests; makers tighten them.

entries.name: ai.cookwala/who-codex-basic
entries.description: Draft nutrition and food-safety rules derived from public WHO, Codex and Sphere guidance. Needs professional review. Renamed on 2026-10-05: see ai.cookwala/basic-nutrition-food-safety.

entries.name: ai.cookwala/kitchen-agent-safety
entries.description: Ten promptfoo test cases for AI agents acting in kitchens (Core section 6 rules). Draft 0.1.

entries.name: ai.cookwala/basic-nutrition-food-safety
entries.description: Draft nutrition and food-safety rules derived from public WHO, Codex and Sphere guidance (sources, not partners; none has reviewed them). Needs professional review. Replaces ai.cookwala/who-codex-basic.
